values.claim: tmpstr is reserved with 63 bytes; tmpbuf points to its mutable data; snprintf is called with buffer size 64 and returns tmplen, the number of characters that would have been written excluding the terminating null.
If tmplen < 64 and tmpbuf is non-null and tmpbuf[0] is not a digit, tmpstr is resized to tmplen and returned.
If tmplen >= 64, tmpstr is reallocated with tmplen bytes, tmpbuf is updated to its mutable data, and snprintf is called with buffer size tmplen + 1.
If dec is nonzero, dp is set to the first occurrence in tmpbuf of '.' or ','; otherwise dp is null.
integral is the offset of dp from tmpbuf when dp is non-null, otherwise integral equals tmplen.
When thousand_sep is non-empty, integral is increased by ((integral-1)/3) * thousand_sep.size(), after checking for overflow.
reslen starts as integral; if dec is nonzero, reslen is increased by dec and, when dec_point is non-empty, by dec_point.size().
If is_negative is true, reslen is incremented by one for the minus sign.

executions.claim: After the negative check, d >= 0; after the dec check, dec >= 0; php_math_round is then called with nonnegative d and dec.

Continuing past the early returns implies tmplen >= 0 and, if tmplen < 64, tmpbuf is non-null and tmpbuf[0] is a digit; if tmplen >= 64, the second snprintf also yields tmplen >= 0 and tmpbuf non-null with tmpbuf[0] a digit.
If dec is nonzero, dp is the first '.' or ',' in tmpbuf or null; if dec is zero, dp is null.
If dp is non-null, integral is the offset of the decimal point from tmpbuf; otherwise integral equals tmplen.
When thousand_sep is non-empty, execution continues only if integral + thousand_sep.size() * ((integral-1)/3) >= integral; integral is then increased by ((integral-1)/3) * thousand_sep.size().

If dec is nonzero, reslen is increased by dec and, when dec_point is non-empty, execution continues only if reslen + dec_point.size() >= dec_point.size(); reslen is then increased by dec_point.size().
If is_negative is nonzero, reslen is incremented by one before the result buffer is allocated.
s is initialized to tmpbuf + tmplen - 1.
t is initialized to resbuf + reslen - 1.
When dec is nonzero, declen is s - dp if dp is non-null, otherwise 0; topad is dec - declen if dec > declen, otherwise 0.
When dp is non-null, s is decreased by declen + 1 and t is decreased by declen before copying declen bytes from dp + 1 to t + 1.
When dec_point is non-empty, dec_point.size() bytes are copied to t + (1 - dec_point.size()) and t is decreased by dec_point.size().

The loop continues while s >= tmpbuf; each iteration copies *s to *t and decrements both, and when thousand_sep is non-empty and ++count is divisible by 3 and s >= tmpbuf, thousand_sep is copied before t and t is decreased by thousand_sep.size().
If is_negative is nonzero, '-' is written at *t and t is decremented.
